name: smwgraphics-magma-ice-castle
title: Magma-Ice Castle
description:
So, this is just a little castle tileset I threw together, it comes in two versions: an ice version and a magma version, if you're creative you could even combine these into a castle of some kind, but yeah, it has holographic platforms, pillars and spikes.

Enjoy!

Please give credit if used!
